capabilities: Chat with an OpenClaw agent from a sidebar panel
Send the active note as chat context
Show tool calls (files read/written, commands, fetched pages)
Persist chat history across devices via Obsidian Sync
Connect to a gateway over Tailscale with token auth
extras: A one-line patch to the OpenClaw gateway is required to accept Obsidian's origin, and it must be re-applied after every gateway update; an upstream fix is being tracked. Setup requires editing config on the gateway machine and approving each device.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to converse with a self-hosted AI agent that treats the vault as its workspace from within the app.

relations.evidence: Chat with your OpenClaw AI agent directly from Obsidian.
Tailscale encrypts all traffic (WireGuard VPN), gateway token authenticates connections
Chat history and tool calls persist via Obsidian Sync
If you want pre-release builds: - Install BRAT - BRAT → Add Beta Plugin

summary: Sidebar chat client for a self-hosted OpenClaw AI agent, connected over Tailscale, with streaming replies and send-note-as-context commands.
